measured_batch_order: Alternate first32/stress then stress/first32 each round
scratch_policy: Step disposable parameters at frozen learning rate; restore initialization and zero moments/counter after every call; retain no learned trajectory
projection: 1.5 * (full observed worker wall time, including Python startup, initialization, all priming/probes/checks/restoration + 800 * maximum per-batch warm P95 full-update time)
percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.95; retain all samples and report every configuration; no fastest selection
qualification_success: Every configuration passes timing, memory, restoration, finite gradient/state and independent evidence audit; retain original v1 NO_GO
retry_policy: One scheduled invocation; exclusive output; stop on any failure; no repeats seeking success
